Research group at RMIT University

S3 Lab

Safe, Sustainable, Smart Materials & Systems

We study how materials and systems respond to heat and fire, with applications in battery energy storage and the built environment.

Meet the team ↓

Research

Battery and energy storage safety

We investigate how battery materials and systems behave under thermal stress and how passive protection can reduce fire risks in residential energy storage.

Fire-resistant materials

We study how the composition and structure of protective materials affect their response to heat and fire, with applications in insulation, composites and coatings.

Thermal management in buildings

We explore how building materials can reduce heat gain through passive cooling while meeting fire safety needs.

Research project

Passive fire protection for residential battery energy storage

Dr Wei Wang provides senior research supervision and guides experimental planning on a project investigating passive protection for residential battery installations. The project brings together expertise in battery materials and fire safety engineering.
